task: NC-T4 footage research (free London footage for H5)
method_notes: Commons: API generator=search 'filetype:video <query>' (24 queries) + categorymembers 'Category:Videos from London'; the categories 'Videos of the City of London', 'Videos of St Paul's Cathedral', 'Videos of the River Thames in London', 'Time-lapse videos of London' returned 0 members.
Commons viewpoints checked by looking at still frames (thumb.wikimedia.org seek=) for 6 files; no video files downloaded.
Pexels/Pixabay/Getty/Storyblocks: metadata read via WebFetch (summarising tool); Pexels/Pixabay frames NOT viewed — viewpoint is from title/description only.
